items.body: Thanks for the detailed report. This issue appears to concern the kube-prometheus-stack Helm chart and the Prometheus Operator, which are maintained outside the Prometheus server repository. For chart-related deployment or reconciliation issues, please open an issue at https://github.com/prometheus-community/helm-charts or https://github.com/prometheus-operator/prometheus-operator, where the maintainers of those projects can best assist you.

items.message: Decision: OTHER_PROJECT. Precheck: not maintainer-authored, bug template used but missing system/version/config sections, mentions to kube-prometheus-stack Helm chart and Prometheus Operator. Duplicate candidate rejected (not same symptom/component). No valid component label for this repo. Comment posted to direct reporter to the correct projects.
